title:
Stage 1 forge tier — increment 2b ONLY: the covenant engine logic (REQ-4). Authoritative spec: .design/stage1-forge-tier.md REQ-4 + AC-8; sequencing in .design/stage1-forge-tier-kickoff-plan.md. Builds on TWO merged predecessors: (foundation, #20) Engine::discharge already takes a non-optional &CovenantRecord param and CovenantRefuted is already wired as a Counterexample-class hard fail in degrade.rs LadderAction + exists as a CertVerdict variant; (2a, #29) the witness { inhabit (...); falsify N; } surface is already PARSED into the AST (Item::Forge). This increment builds the LOGIC that consumes them. Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit; revert anything that fails. If low on time or budget, STOP at a sub-unit boundary and report what landed; the branch is resumable.

SCOPE: REQ-4 covenant logic ONLY. OUT OF SCOPE (do not build): REQ-3 surface syntax (DONE in 2a — consume it, do not re-do), tactic battery (2c, REQ-5), anti-Goodhart re-elaboration (2d, REQ-6), goal/fill proof view (2e, REQ-7), relax engine (2f, REQ-8b), lemma library (3, REQ-9).

DELIVERABLES:
1. Build the CovenantRecord PRODUCER: parse the 2a witness AST (inhabit witnesses + a falsify budget) into the CovenantRecord the foundation threads into Engine::discharge. inhabit witnesses are type-checked AND EXECUTED against the item's req (a witness that does not satisfy req is a covenant error, surfaced loudly — never silently dropped).
2. falsify: ride the SplitMix64 generator (thermite-tv/src/gen.rs Rng — deterministic, no clock) aimed at the item's EXECUTABLE semantics (the same executable-semantics surface the TV generator targets); Q3 default is falsify 50_000 with a FIXED seed when the budget is unstated. A falsify hit (an input satisfying req for which the executable body violates ens) is the hard-fail verdict CovenantRefuted with the concrete counterexample attached — same never-degrades treatment as Counterexample (the foundation already wired the LadderAction; here, PRODUCE the verdict).
3. covenant-before-burn, enforced STRUCTURALLY (R-COV-1): the L3 proof-search / burn path cannot start without a valid covenant record — a tested invariant in the closure-instrumented degrade.rs style (assert the proof-search closure is never invoked without a covenant). Q3: a forge-routed item must carry at least one AUTHOR-stated witness (generator-synthesized witnesses may augment but cannot be the only ones); an item missing the author witness is refused before burn, named.
4. Certificate covenant evidence block: per Q-ORACLE (already resolved in the spec) the covenant record is ORACLE-INCLUDED — witness count, falsify generated/refuted counts, and the seed — all deterministic (fixed seed). NEW forge-tier goldens carry the covenant block from day one; v1 conformance items have no covenant so their oracle subset stays BYTE-IDENTICAL (verify the 7 v1 golden certs are unchanged).

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge; cargo clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --check; for any Lean touch, lake build + the axiom probe; AND forge check over conformance still matches all v1 golden certs with oracle_subset byte-identical for v1 items. AC-8 specifically: an item with forge-routed clauses and NO witness block does not reach proof search (tested structurally); a planted-bug example dies as CovenantRefuted with the concrete counterexample in the certificate; the unstated-budget default is 50,000 with a fixed seed recorded. No stubs/TODOs; fix warnings rather than suppress.

REGISTRY: flip REQ-S1-4 in .design/reqs/registry.toml from partial to shipped (the covenant logic completes REQ-4) with typed evidence; regenerate the status view; req-registry.py --check clean. Do NOT hand-write a ## REQ status comment table.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage / combinator-menu change (thermite-spec REGISTRY untouched); do NOT flip the README/docs headline (G1 gate only, R-GATE-1); never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json; additive certs only for v1 items (the covenant block is new forge-tier evidence, oracle-included, deterministic). One branch; open ONE PR for increment 2b.
